test.create_query: CREATE TABLE text_index_pattern_bypass_cache ( part UInt8, id UInt64, message String, INDEX idx(message) TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha) ) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY part ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO text_index_pattern_bypass_cache SELECT number % 8, number, concat( 'q', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> char(97 + intDiv(number, toUInt64(pow(26, i))) % 26), range(5))), if(intDiv(number, 8) % 100 < 6, concat(' qzzzzzz', char(97 + intDiv(number, 8) % 100)), '')) FROM numbers(200000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM text_index_pattern_bypass_cache WHERE message LIKE '%q%'
SELECT count() FROM text_index_pattern_bypass_cache WHERE message ILIKE '%Q%'
